messages.subject: The first topic
parts:
When we created the lavaan.org website, we envisioned that sooner or later, the website would host a user-based forum. For several reasons, this never happened. In the next coming months, we plan to redesign lavaan.org. In those new plans, there is no room anymore for a website-based forum. Instead, I will try to divert all questions and discussions about lavaan to this discussion group. For bug reports, please report an issue at github (https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/issues).

Yves.
http://lavaan.org
